name: Hanthawaddy Kingdom
native: ဟံသာဝတီ နေပြည်တော် (Hanthawaddy Naypyidaw)
ဍုၚ် ဟံသာဝတဳ (Mon: Hongsawatoi)

predecessors.name: Pagan Kingdom
predecessors.text: Martaban province, which Gadu (Wareru) seized from Pagan in 1285 and declared a kingdom on 30 January 1287

successors.name: Toungoo Empire
successors.text: Pegu and the delta in late 1538-1539, Martaban and the south in May 1541

ledger.x: 30 January 1287: Gadu (Wareru) declares himself king of Martaban.

c. 1296: Wareru defeats his ally and rival Tarabya, 'the self-proclaimed king of Pegu (Bago)', who 'had gained control of both Pegu and Dala', and 'emerged as the sole ruler of three Mon-speaking provinces of Bassein, Pegu and Martaban c. 1296' (Wareru page; 'By late 1296, the relationship had deteriorated to the…
1369/70: the court moves from Martaban to Hanthawaddy Pegu.
1391: the first phase of the war ends in a truce.
1401: Pegu invades Upper Burma in force and the war resumes.
1412: Arakan becomes a tributary of Pegu.
1415: Minye Kyawswa of Ava conquers the Irrawaddy delta.
March 1415: Minye Kyawswa is killed and Pegu 'reconquered' the delta in 1415.
1421: the tribute of Arakan ends with Razadarit's death.
Early 1424: the war ends in stalemate.
May 1541: Toungoo annexes Martaban, Moulmein and the south.
May 1541: the last Hanthawaddy king falls at Martaban and Toungoo annexes the Mon kingdom (infobox 'Toungoo annexed Hanthawaddy').

wars.name: Mottama rebellion
wars.outcome: 'Mottama was in open rebellion from 1363 to 1388'; Razadarit 'reunified his provinces', taking Donwun by late 1388.

wars.name: Forty Years' War
wars.outcome: Stalemate: 'preserving the independence of Hanthawaddy'; Ava held Kale, Mohnyin and Launggyet from 1404-1406 and the delta briefly in 1415; Arakan was a Pegu tributary 1412-1421.

wars.name: Toungoo-Hanthawaddy War
wars.outcome: Toungoo took Pegu in late 1538, the delta in 1538-39 and Martaban in May 1541 and annexed Hanthawaddy.

certainty.note: The Mon heartland (Martaban, Pegu, the delta) is a coherent outline, but no page gives a frontier; the Tenasserim and Tavoy side, and the Prome and Toungoo frontier, are approximate.
